title: Daily publish retrospective seed
summary: Seed record proving daily_publish retrospectives use sanitized project records rather than raw automation logs.

degraded_sections.message: This seed documents the contract shape only; live daily runs should write date-specific sanitized records.

lessons.lesson: Daily publish retrospectives need a durable project-level record that survives beyond the automation workspace.
lessons.evidence: The user required committed sanitized retrospective records as the authoritative reference.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep the daily runner writer, publish finalizer, correction rollup, and publish allowlist tests green so each scheduled run leaves sanitized records.

suggestions.issue: Daily runner needed to call a retrospective writer and publish-result correction flow automatically.
suggestions.evidence: The daily runner now writes a sanitized daily_publish record before validation, finalizes it before real publish, appends a blocked rollup correction when publish and fallback both fail, and publish staging is scoped to selected-date daily_publish or rollup records plus the index.
suggestions.suggestion: Generate one sanitized daily_publish retrospective during each daily runner handoff, finalize it before real publish, and append a correction rollup on blocked publish completion.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Every scheduled run leaves consistent sanitized final or correction records without manual reconstruction or private log leakage.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented through the retrospective writer and publish boundary tests.
validation_evidence: daily runner writes sanitized daily publish retrospective before validation
daily runner finalizes publish retrospectives before real publish
daily runner writes blocked correction rollup when publish and fallback fail
daily dry-run stages sanitized retrospective records for the selected date
daily dry-run stages selected-date rollup correction retrospective records
publish keeps dirty retrospective records scoped to the selected report date

followups.action: Daily runner writes sanitized daily_publish records before validation, finalizes them before real publish, appends blocked correction rollups when publish and fallback both fail, and publish paths only submit selected-date daily_publish or rollup records plus the index.
